name: MemGator
what_it_holds: Go-based Memento aggregator (2.2k-star family topic listing shows it at 80 stars under a related search) that queries multiple web archives at once (Internet Archive, archive.today, UK Web Archive, etc.) via the Memento protocol (RFC 7089) to find all known archived copies of a URL.
why_useful: Cross-archive discovery (not just the Internet Archive) for old AirDNA/Mashvisor/Inside-Airbnb pages that might have been captured only by a national web archive rather than archive.org.
themes: Wayback Machine / Internet Archive tooling and archived-page datasets (archived airbnb.com pages, archived AirDNA/Mashvisor market pages, archived Inside Airbnb site)
why_all: Cross-archive discovery (not just the Internet Archive) for old AirDNA/Mashvisor/Inside-Airbnb pages that might have been captured only by a national web archive rather than archive.org.

name: awesome-memento
what_it_holds: Curated list (122 stars) of Memento-protocol / web-archiving software and literature: py-memento-client, mcurl, memento-cli, MemGator, and academic papers on temporal web archiving.
why_useful: One-stop index to find additional Wayback/Memento clients beyond what a keyword search surfaces directly; useful as a jumping-off point for a deeper follow-up pass on this theme, not itself a data source.
themes: Wayback Machine / Internet Archive tooling and archived-page datasets (archived airbnb.com pages, archived AirDNA/Mashvisor market pages, archived Inside Airbnb site)
why_all: One-stop index to find additional Wayback/Memento clients beyond what a keyword search surfaces directly; useful as a jumping-off point for a deeper follow-up pass on this theme, not itself a data source.

name: ArchiveBox
what_it_holds: Large (28.4k stars) self-hosted web-archiving tool that takes a list of URLs/browser history/bookmarks and saves full-fidelity local copies (HTML, JS, PDFs, media, screenshots, WARC) going forward; not a Wayback Machine retrieval tool per se but a self-hosted archive-creation tool that can also import existing Wayback snapshots.
why_useful: Could be pointed at a watch-list of AirDNA/Mashvisor/Airbnb newsroom URLs to start building our OWN point-in-time archive from today forward (complements the retroactive Wayback-retrieval tools above); large, actively maintained, well-documented.
size_hint: self-hosted tool, storage scales with what you archive
themes: Wayback Machine / Internet Archive tooling and archived-page datasets (archived airbnb.com pages, archived AirDNA/Mashvisor market pages, archived Inside Airbnb site)
why_all: Could be pointed at a watch-list of AirDNA/Mashvisor/Airbnb newsroom URLs to start building our OWN point-in-time archive from today forward (complements the retroactive Wayback-retrieval tools above); large, actively maintained, well-documented.

name: warcio.js
what_it_holds: JavaScript/Node port of warcio for streaming WARC IO in browser or Node contexts. 55 stars, MIT, updated 4 Sep 2026.
why_useful: Alternative WARC-reading tool if any pipeline work moves to a JS/browser context (e.g. a Wayback-viewer style tool for archived AirDNA or STR-platform pages).
themes: Common Crawl tooling: cdx-toolkit, warcio, host-level indexes, columnar index queries; datasets derived from Common Crawl for travel sites
why_all: Alternative WARC-reading tool if any pipeline work moves to a JS/browser context (e.g. a Wayback-viewer style tool for archived AirDNA or STR-platform pages).

name: scrapy-warcio
what_it_holds: Internet Archive extension adding WARC-writing support to the Scrapy crawling framework. 24 stars, updated 15 Dec 2025.
why_useful: Would let a future (human-approved) scrape of a non-Airbnb STR/travel site be captured in standard WARC format so it becomes point-in-time archivable, consistent with how Common Crawl stores pages.
